subject: Important Update: Meeting Schedule Changes
body: Dear Team, I hope this message finds you well. Due to unforeseen circumstances, we need to adjust the schedule for our upcoming project meeting. The new meeting time will be on Friday at 3:00 PM. Your attendance is crucial as we will be discussing key project milestones and deliverables. Please update your calendars accordingly. Thank you for your understanding and flexibility. Best regards, [Your Name]
